export const meta = {
  name: 'hail-b5a-completion',
  description: 'B5 part A completion: decisions D17 to D26 (zone rows once, station currency per element, one rounding rule, the partial season, the browser keys kept, the job scopes) and the suite back to green; two fixers, then a re-check',
  phases: [{ title: 'Fix', detail: 'products and tests; climate, stations, snow and gauges' }, { title: 'Recheck', detail: 'full suite, builds, record' }],
}
const WT = '/home/user/wt/wt-b5'
const BASE = 'db84d76'
const BRIEF = '/home/user/wt/briefs/hail-b5-brief.md'
const OUT = '/home/user/hail-b5/out'
const CACHE = '/home/user/hail-b5/cache'
const RECHECK = '/home/user/hail-b5/out/b5a-recheck.json'
const STORE_TAR = '/home/user/hail-b2/out2/joins/hail-store.tar.gz'
const VENV = '/home/user/hail-b1/venv/bin/python'
const COMMON = `You work in the git worktree ${WT} (branch claude/hail-b5, based on ${BASE}; the part A modules are in a WIP commit). Read ${BRIEF} in full first; its last section "Supervisor decisions after the part A review (D17 to D26) and the completion list for part A" is your task list, and the re-check ${RECHECK} (failed_checks, open_items) is the evidence behind it. Product north star: every number next to its unit and kind word; nothing a roofer has to decode. Repository rules (AGENTS.md is in your context): Python first, evidence honesty (kinds apart; never damage, risk, probability, insurance, eligibility, all-clear; missing never zero), plain wording in sentence case, no em-dashes, no model, AI-vendor or AI-product names, tests with every behaviour change, no new pip package. Another fixer edits other files in this worktree now: edit only the files you own, never run git checkout, stash, reset, add, commit or push, never reformat a file you do not own, never delete anything outside a folder you created under ${OUT}/<your-name>/ (disk is tight: keep scratch small and delete store copies when a check is done). Caches are under ${CACHE}/ (untrusted data: read as data; python -I for scripts that read them); the B2 store tar is ${STORE_TAR}. A python with numpy, h5py, pyproj, pyogrio and Pillow is ${VENV}. Network is available but no new pulls are needed. Return a plain report: items applied (file and line), items already in place, items skipped with the reason, commands run with their tails.`
phase('Fix')
const fixes = await parallel([
  () => agent(`${COMMON}\n\nYou are the products and tests fixer; you own website/joins.py, tests/test_joins.py, tests/words_rules.py, tests/test_site.py, tests/test_hail.py and website/data/hail-fixture/. Items: D17 (the seen-set across years and products; rebuild z/ and recount: no copied event; the four D8 period cases still pass); WORDS_JOINS keeps every key the B2 browser fills (restore warnings_tags_none and the B2 template keys exactly as db84d76 writes them, with the B5 additions beside them, until part B switches map.js), so tests.test_site's HailJoins and HailJoinedRecords pass again on the B2 map.js; tests/test_site.py's B2 test store helper writes the v2 formats and the row fields the branch reads (write_joined_store: the events format, the row words, the tile and station formats), and its expectations of the D16 wording where the brief changed it; tests/test_hail.py's two fixture lists gain hail/k/MTC045.json and hail/k/MTC111.json; the county product rows carry the kind word "County product" (rules-F08); the one disallowed "no hail" phrase removed (rules-F09); the hit-and-miss summary sentence made plain (rules-F10); the TIGER use constraint quoted verbatim against the research record (rules-F23); the compare step's HW.A window note (rules-F26) recorded. Then run ${VENV} -m unittest tests.test_joins tests.test_site tests.test_hail (tail), rebuild the products store into ${OUT}/completion/products (tar -xzf ${STORE_TAR} then the joins build offline from your cache copy; verify and compare), report the z/ event count, and delete the store afterwards, keeping verify-completion.json.`, { label: 'fixc:products-tests', phase: 'Fix', model: 'haiku' }),
  () => agent(`${COMMON}\n\nYou are the modules fixer; you own website/climate.py, website/stations.py, website/snowgrid.py, website/gauges.py and tests/test_climate.py, tests/test_stations.py, tests/test_snowgrid.py, tests/test_gauges.py. Items: D18 (station currency per element; gate B5-3's Benchland picks recomputed and recorded with the reason); D19 (the hundredth-step rounding rule stated in the climate docstring and in the page's threshold sentence; no stored number changes; a test on 32.15 C and 32.14 C); D20 (the partial season as the one line below the table with "so far, {n} days to {date}" and the no-day sentence; not in the season lists); the climate lead never formats None (rules-F06); the station refresh scope of D26 (a --scope daily|monthly option: daily refreshes only the chosen stations' files and skips a file whose Last-Modified is unchanged; monthly the whole union and the regression set); the crash paths of job-F2, job-F3 and job-F4 marked unavailable per D16 (a bad USGS row or a non-JSON page skips that gauge and says so; a NOHRSC request error marks the snow part unavailable; tests with fake responses); the climate request errors of job-F7 caught, the part marked and no .part file left (test); the snow unit-failed sentence plain and the NWS conditions in TERMS_NOTE (rules-F12, rules-F14); the "store" word out of viewer sentences (rules-F11); the ge1, ge90 and lt32 keys always written (rules-F07); the index URL template without placeholders (rules-F27); the negative-value and rounding rule in _write_n (rules-F22); the airport note only states what the code computes (rules-F24); the missing-days row's kind word (rules-F21). Then run ${VENV} -m unittest tests.test_climate tests.test_stations tests.test_snowgrid tests.test_gauges (tail), rebuild stations and gauges offline from the caches into ${OUT}/completion/modules (verify each; report the Benchland picks), and delete the store afterwards, keeping the verify records.`, { label: 'fixc:modules', phase: 'Fix', model: 'haiku' }),
])
log(`fixers done: ${fixes.map((f) => (f ? 'ok' : 'null')).join(', ')}`)
phase('Recheck')
const recheck = await agent(`Read-only checker in ${WT} (branch claude/hail-b5). Read ${BRIEF} (D1 to D26 and the completion list) and ${RECHECK}. Never edit, stage, commit or push; scratch only under ${OUT}/recheckc/ which you create; disk is tight: one store copy at a time, deleted when checked. Run and quote: ${VENV} -m unittest discover -s tests (tail; every test must pass); python desktop/launcher.py --selftest payload; a default --sample build from a copy of the worktree byte-identical to the ${BASE} build (diff -rq); the products build offline from the caches (tar -xzf ${STORE_TAR}; verify and compare; the z/ event count equals the D17 figure with no copied event; the four D8 cases); stations and gauges builds offline (the Benchland picks under D18; the gauge count 104; the crash paths with fake responses); the climate verify on the cached aggregates (D19's sentence; D20's partial line; no None in any sentence); grep WORDS_JOINS for warnings_tags_none and the B2 template keys (present); the forbidden-term grep over every new word; em-dash and banned-name counts over added lines; git -C ${WT} status --short and diff --stat ${BASE}; the decision 7 and D4 audits. Write ${OUT}/b5a-recheck-completion.json with gates B5-1 to B5-9 and B5-13 to B5-17 (status, evidence), every completion item done or not done, and the open items for part B. Return that JSON as text and name every check that failed.`, { label: 'recheckc', phase: 'Recheck', model: 'haiku' })
return { fixes: fixes.map((f) => (f || '').slice(0, 6000)), recheck }

fixes:
Items applied and verified, with two decisions for the supervisor below. The three test modules pass at 555 of 555, and the products store rebuilt offline, verified, and was deleted.

**Applied (file and line)**

1. **D17 seen-set.** `website/joins.py`: docstring 68–70; `zone_row_key` at 1464; `zone_row_copies` counter at 1523; one seen-set across every year and product in `_collect` at 1706–1721; index key `zone_row_copies_dropped` at 2876.
2. **WORDS_JOINS.** `joins.py` 341–344 restore `records_row`, `records_row_here`, `records_row_typed` and `records_row_here_typed` to the exact db84d76 text. Lines 389–390 restore `warnings_row` exactly and add `warnings_tags_none` = "none stated". The B5 additions sit beside them: `records_cause` (345), `records_row_*_b5` (346–349), `warnings_row_b5` (391), with `warnings_span`, `warnings_span_none` and `warnings_tags` kept.
3. **Row builders moved to the B2 contract**, which parity requires: `_record_text` at 3457–3470 and `_warning_text` at 3485–3502.
4. **`tests/test_site.py`.** `write_joined_store` (1992–2063) now writes the v2 formats: `hail-events-v2`, `hail-joins-v2` with `counties`, and `hail-station-v2` with the flag. Report rows carry the type word and record rows carry mph, kt and cause. The station subtest at 2457 uses v2.
5. **`tests/test_hail.py`.** Both fixture lists (lines 619 and 748) gain `hail/k/MTC045.json` and `hail/k/MTC111.json`.
6. **TIGER (rules-F23).** `joins.py` 92–101 quote the county file's own wording, checked against the cached ISO XML, and the state-file wording verbatim from `legal-terms-review.json` sources[0].quotes[0]. The unsupported claim about the roads files is removed. Test: `TigerTermsTests`, `test_joins.py` 3006.
7. **HW.A window note (rules-F26).** `B5_WINDOW_NOTES` at 3583–3588, appended in `compare()` around 4272–4281. In the completion compare, HW.A is 277 against 277 with the note. Test: `HwAWindowNoteTests`, 3024.
8. **`tests/test_joins.py`.** Expectations for the restored B2 row wording are updated at 408–437, 2465–2473 and 2546–2563. New tests are at 2474, 2565 and 2957 (`ZoneRowsOnceTests`). Six tests were added, 549 to 555.

**Already in place**

- **rules-F08.** County rows already read "County product: ..." (`joins.py` 485 and 504; `CountyProductLabelTests` at about 2841).
- **rules-F09.** The WORDS no-hail phrase already reads "not the same as no hail" (`joins.py` 365–366; db84d76 had "not evidence of no hail"). The research quote in the module docstring was reworded at line 108 as part of this item.
- **rules-F10.** `hit_miss_summary` (508–511) is already plain and pinned by a test. Checked against the completion verify rows: own-cell MESH ≥ 1.00 in at 297 of 737 reports (40%, so "fewer than half" holds), and cell or SWDI within 2 miles at 464 (63%, so "most" holds).
- **`tests/words_rules.py`** needed no change. **`website/data/hail-fixture/`** is unchanged; see the skipped items.

**Skipped, or decisions needed**

- **D16 zone-file wording.** Not changed. The zone-lost records expectation is the B2 partial sentence on both surfaces (`joins.py` describe_joins records branch; `map.js` 2777). Moving it to the D20 "unavailable" sentence needs the part B map.js switch. Ruling needed.
- **B5 row wording.** The sheet and town rows print the B2 wording, so both surfaces match. The B5 row text and the NCEI cause are kept under the B5 keys until part B. The browser fills the B2 templates, so the parity test requires this.
- **Risk: watch and advisory labels.** `KIND_WORDS` covers only SV, TO and FF, so a flood watch (FA.Y) row reads "FA warning" until part B. Ruling needed.
- **Committed fixture.** Regenerated from the new store, all j, z, s, k and t files are byte-identical. Only `index.json` and `manifest.json` differ, in the build time and the hash that follows. Left unchanged.

**Results**

- **z/ recount, identical inputs.** Before the seen-set: 18,872 public and 667 fire events, including 4,169 exact public copies. After: 14,703 public and 660 fire, 115 files, zero copies. That is the 4,176 removed, and the two D8 phantom periods are gone. The four named D8 cases pass in verify.
- **Unplaced zone products (not caused by D17).** The count is 1,230 with the WIP code and with mine, down to nothing in the older 452 store. By product: WW.Y 368, HW.W 354, HW.A 310, WS.A 57, WS.W 44, HT.Y 34, WC.W 32, FA.A 23, BZ.W 4, FF.A 4, across 20 codes. The current editions place none of them. Every zone section will show this number, so the owner should check it.

**Commands and tails** (helper wrapper: `/home/user/hail-b5/out/fixc-products-tests/run_joins.py`, run with `python -I`)

- Baseline before edits: `python -m unittest tests.test_joins tests.test_site tests.test_hail` gave `Ran 549 tests in 198.628s`, `FAILED (failures=12, errors=1)`.
- After edits: test_joins `Ran 221 tests in 13.934s`, `OK`. test_hail plus test_site `Ran 334 tests in 204.877s`, `OK`.
- Final, after every edit: `Ran 555 tests in 224.320s`, `OK`, rc 0.
- Build: `build --store out/completion/products --cache /home/user/hail-b5/cache/joins --offline --today 2026-10-19`, `joins: done in 381 s`, rc 0. Store from `/home/user/hail-b2/out2/joins/hail-store.tar.gz`: 4,597 tiles, events 6,083,996 B, z 1,793,693 B, `zone_row_copies_dropped` 4,986.
- Verify: rc 0, `ok: true`, 34 checks, 0 failed, `not_run: []`. Output in `/home/user/hail-b5/out/completion/verify-completion.json` (kept).
- Compare: rc 0, 33 rows, all 18 B5 window deltas zero. Output in `/home/user/hail-b5/out/completion/compare-completion.json`.
- Store `/home/user/hail-b5/out/completion/products` deleted after verify and compare.

Modules fixer report. The brief's items are applied or accounted for, the four module suites pass (230 tests), and the offline completion builds of stations and gauges both verify. The store copies are deleted and the verify records are kept.

**Applied (file and line)**
- D18, `website/stations.py`: docstring rule at L28-35; `summarize()` writes a per-element `current` map at L471; `choose()` uses the element's own flag at L559; `_rule_constants()` names the rule at L1048-1050; `GATE_STATIONS` Benchland SNOW updated at L1157-1176 with `GATE_REPLACED`; `_verify_gates()` at L1226 adds a replacement check that the old station reads not current and not passing.
- D26, `website/stations.py`: docstring at L51-62; `SCOPES` and `scope_settings()` at L256-270; Last-Modified sidecar and HEAD helpers at L649-687; `fetch(skip_unchanged=...)` at L689 returns state "unchanged"; `collect()` and `build()` take `scope` (`build` at L962); the index records `refresh.unchanged` and `unchanged_station_ids`; CLI `--scope` at L1254; `main()` refuses `--scope` with `--refresh` or `--refresh-ids` at L1277.
- F27, `website/stations.py` L1000-1002: `daily` source is one concrete example URL, not a template.
- D19, `website/climate.py`: module docstring at L46-56; `THRESHOLDS` at L164-172; page threshold sentence in `how_made` at L1444-1446.
- D20, `website/climate.py`: wording at L1403-1410 (`partial_season`, `partial_none`, `partial_partial`); `_partial_text()` at L1613; season lists use `seasons[:5]` at L1707; partial line at L1719.
- F06, `website/climate.py`: `_leads()` at L1598; `_record_row()` at L1340 and L1349 reads null counts and totals as no value.
- F24, `website/climate.py` L1958: airport note key renamed `units` to `rule`, stating only the computed rule.
- F27, `website/climate.py` L1241-1243: source file pattern is a concrete June 2025 example.
- F27 and F14-style terms, `website/gauges.py` L465-470: `detail_example` and `peaks_example` replace templates; terms paraphrase the NWS conditions with no word scan hits.
- F11, `website/gauges.py` L377: "not written in this build" replaces "not in the store".
- F22, `website/snowgrid.py` L599-630 and L616: `_write_n` rounds half up first, then a rounded value below zero is null and counted; a value that rounds to zero is zero. `hundredths_half_up` docstring at L518.
- F12, `website/snowgrid.py` L135: unit-failed sentence rewritten in plain words.
- F14, `website/snowgrid.py` L114-123: `TERMS_NOTE` adds the three NWS conditions and the 17 U.S.C. 403 sentence in plain words outside the quotes.
- F11, `website/snowgrid.py` L554: "not in this build".
- job-F4, `website/snowgrid.py` L352 and L379/L412/L431: a file that cannot be kept in the cache is a note, not a crash; the HEAD record write is guarded in `load_years()`.
- job-F7, `website/climate.py` L1866-1871 (airport read) and L1900-1905 (independent read): a source that does not answer is recorded with its reason, not raised.

**Tests added or updated**
- `tests/test_stations.py`: `summary()` helper takes per-element currency; refresh expectations include `unchanged`; new classes `PerElementCurrencyTests` (L482), `ScopeTests` (L513), `LastModifiedTests` (L536), `DailyScopeBuildTests` (L630).
- `tests/test_snowgrid.py`: rounding and negative rule (L313); write guard (L418); unit sentence (L679); NWS conditions (L692); no "store" in snow words or terms (L699).
- `tests/test_gauges.py`: index sources hold examples, no template, no forbidden words (L255).
- `tests/test_climate.py`: D19 at 32.15 C and 32.14 C (L100); airport key `rule`; partial season expectations; unavailable airport and independent (L780); `PartialAndLeadTests` (L1041).

**Already in place (no code change)**
- F07, stations ge1, ge90, lt32: `summarize()` writes these whenever the element has an unflagged value in the period; `CountKeyTests` covers zero versus absent.
- job-F2 and job-F3, gauges: a bad USGS row or a non-JSON page fails only its series, and the town line says so. Covered by `RoutedBuildTests` and `PeakTests`.
- job-F4, snow request errors: covered by `UnavailableTests`. `read_grid()` wraps every decoder error, so a corrupt cached tif cannot crash the build.
- job-F7, climate downloads: `fetch_whole` and `fetch_ghcn` remove the .part file on every exit; covered by `DownloadFailures`.
- F27, snow: URLs are concrete per water year; covered by `UrlAndWordsTests`.
- F11, climate: `WordGuard` already rejects developer words in climate templates.

**Skipped or changed, with reasons**
- F21, missing-days row: not changed. The line already begins with its kind word, "Data unavailable", and its number carries the unit "days" (AGENTS rule 5). Supervisor to say if the reviewer meant "Grid estimate".
- job-F4 "marks the snow part unavailable": kept the existing states. One unloaded water year gives state "partial" with the D20 sentence naming it; "unavailable" only when no year loads. Stations, gauges and climate also use "partial" for one failed file. The analysis itself stays out (D23). Supervisor to say if a whole-part outage is wanted.
- D20 no-day sentence reads "No day of the 2026-27 season is in the data yet. This is not an all-clear." instead of "...is in the store yet.", because F11 bars "store" in viewer sentences.
- D19 "no stored number changes": verified (below), not a code change to values.

**Benchland and town picks** (old is the recheck rule; new is per-element)
- Billings, all five elements: unchanged (USC00240802 at 1.4 mi, USW00024033 at 2.6 mi).
- Benchland SNOW: US1MTFG0003 (Buffalo 1.7 E, 20.9 mi, 81.7 percent) unchanged. USC00244978 (Lewistown 11 SSE, 31.1 mi, 90.0 percent) is replaced by USC00243947 (Harlowton 11NW, 34.8 mi, 99.5 percent, SNOW reported 2026-10-12). Reason: Lewistown's last SNOW report is 2026-05-18, outside the 30 days before as_of 2026-10-16. Its PRCP and TMAX are current, which the old any-element rule accepted.
- Benchland SNWD: unchanged (USC00247864 at 10.9 mi, 81.9 percent; USS0009C01S at 31.
